explicitExclusions.reason: Test fixtures, not executed by the harness as a hook.

openQuestions.question: Whether the ambient permission posture prompts for Bash(rm:*) during unattended autonomous sessions determines whether the validate-bash finding is medium or critical; this scan covered hooks/ only and did not audit the settings.json permission arrays.
bin/ and scripts/ (about 39k lines) are out of scope for this scan and contain further command-construction surface.

surfaces.label: Bash command permission guards (validate-bash, smart-bash-allowlist, rm-safe-allowlist, ship-rail-push-allow, reset-hard-shadow-allow)
surfaces.notes: The security-decision surface. validate-bash.sh reported. rm-safe-allowlist.sh reviewed and found sound: it is allow-only against an explicit regenerable-path whitelist, rejects globs, ~, .., the bare root and outside-repo absolutes, refuses compound commands, and defers silently rather than allowing when a target is not provably safe.

surfaces.label: Command injection via untrusted tool_input
surfaces.notes: No eval with interpolation and no sh -c / bash -c with interpolated untrusted data anywhere in scope; the repository enforces an explicit no-eval convention. The three yq eval occurrences in teammate-auto-shutdown.sh are the yq subcommand, not shell eval.

surfaces.label: Integrity of emitted permission decisions
surfaces.notes: validate-bash.sh json_escape() escapes backslash before quote and strips control characters, so a command echoed back into a deny reason cannot break out of the JSON string and silently void the decision. Peer hooks build decision JSON with jq -nc --arg, which is safe by construction.

surfaces.label: Temporary file and lock handling
surfaces.notes: notify.sh reported. Other hooks use mktemp or paths under $HOME/.claude.

surfaces.label: Filesystem paths derived from tool_input.file_path
surfaces.notes: backup-before-write.sh consumes .tool_input.file_path but gates on a regular-file test, quotes every expansion, and derives backup names via basename into a fixed $HOME/.claude/backups root; no attacker-controlled component reaches the destination directory.

surfaces.label: Destructive filesystem operations inside hooks
surfaces.notes: Every deletion, move and copy occurrence in scope quotes its operands and targets paths under $HOME/.claude or a mktemp directory; no unquoted expansion reaches a destructive command.

surfaces.label: Network egress from hooks
surfaces.notes: No curl, wget, nc, ssh or scp invocation exists anywhere in scope; hooks are local-only.
